name: Evidence Suite
description: Tests how well an AI can identify empirical support or contradictions.

tasks.billText: Section 101. Beginning with the 2028-2029 school year, each public school shall replace mathematics instruction with astrology instruction. Legislative findings in support of this section cite a survey of 10 social media users who reported that astrological alignment improved student learning.
tasks.rationale: Implausible reasoning is backed only by extremely weak anecdotal support.

tasks.billText: Section 202. All state-funded workforce development programs shall discontinue keyboarding instruction and provide cursive writing instruction instead. The findings for this section rely on anecdotal testimony and a widely shared online video asserting that cursive instruction improves employment outcomes.
tasks.rationale: The policy change rests on anecdotes and viral-media claims rather than reliable evidence.

tasks.billText: Section 303. The Department of Health shall establish a grant program for pediatric providers to send text-message reminders for scheduled childhood vaccination visits. The findings for this section reference randomized evaluations and state pilot programs reporting improved attendance at preventive care appointments.
tasks.rationale: The intervention is supported by randomized evaluations and directly relevant pilot evidence.
